verdict: Leads up sharply, cost down — but key infrastructure milestones remain overdue.
narrative: This period you received 92 leads at a cost of $12.99 per lead across $1,195 in ad spend — and the most recent week showed the strongest momentum, with leads rising 38% while cost per lead fell 40% on less spend. That efficiency gain is real and confirmed against your own prior weeks. However, 10 agreed setup milestones — including your CRM migration, conversion tracking, search campaigns, and landing pages — remain incomplete, some by as many as 84 days, which means the pipeline to capture these leads is not yet fully in place. Closing those milestones is the immediate priority, and website conversion tracking is being repaired so next period's reporting will reflect site-side results alongside ad leads.
